news.title: Russia Oil Revenues Hit Five-Month High on Crude Rally, IEA Says
news.summary: Russia’s October revenues from crude and petroleum-product exports hit the highest since May as the ongoing Iran war bolstered oil prices, according to the International Energy Agency.

news.title: Iran Says Tanker Carrying LNG Hit Mine, Suffered Explosion in Hormuz
news.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards navy said a tanker carrying liquefied natural gas struck a naval mine and suffered an explosion in the Strait of Hormuz on Friday while using what they described was an "unauthorized and dangerous route," state media reported.

news.title: Turkey – Environmental Pollution Fines: Updated for 2027
news.summary: Environmental pollution fines in Turkish waters will increase by 27.83% from 1 January 2027. news.title: New ultra-deep oil & gas discovery marks ‘major breakthrough’ in Bohai Sea
news.summary: CNOOC has revealed an ultra-deep natural gas find in the central Bohai Sea, with a high-yield volcanic well testing at 800,000 cubic meters per day.

news.title: SLB on multi-year integrated drilling quest with European oil & gas operator
news.summary: SLB’s new assignment with Vår Energi aims to drive efficiency and performance across two rigs owned by Transocean and Odfjell Drilling.

news.title: Port of Gothenburg eyes large-scale biogas bunkering in 2027
news.summary: Sweden’s Port of Gothenburg is gearing up to launch a new LBG liquefaction plant next year to enable large-scale liquefied biogas bunkering.

news.title: GULF broadens LNG trading horizons beyond Thailand with PetroChina deal
news.summary: This deal enables GULF to supply 0.3 million tonnes of LNG to PetroChina in 2027, marking its strategic expansion into international trading.

news.title: EU’s Russian Arctic LNG Bill Hits €8.7 Billion as Yamal Faces Shipping Challenge Come January
news.summary: The European Union paid an estimated €8.7 billion for liquefied natural gas from Russia’s Yamal project in the first 10 months of 2026, exceeding the estimated total for all of 2025, as the countdown to a ban on Russian LNG imports enters its final weeks.

news.title: With restructuring done, Impact Oil & Gas turns into pure-play Namibia explorer
news.summary: The corporate restructuring has established a pure-play Namibia-focused development and exploration business, anchored by the Venus project.

news.title: Murphy Oil gains stronger foothold offshore Cameroon with block quartet

news.title: ADNOC widens its Asian footprint with decade-long LNG offtake deal

news.title: ADES rig duo picks up multimillion-dollar assignments offshore India
